definitions: A sudden forceful closing of a door or lid.
A critical or insulting remark or attack.
A poetry slam, a competition in which poets read or recite original work.
In bridge, a contract to take all or all but one of the tricks.
examples: The door slams echoed through the house.
His speech was full of slams against the government.
She won the poetry slams last night.
They bid for grand slams in the final round.
